# Quiz

> Property-based testing for Hoon. A library (`lib/quiz.hoon`) and
> generator, plus an Urbit Gall application: `%quiz` runs property
> documents and existing Clay `test-*` suites as bounded, replayable jobs, and
> `%quiz-web` serves a browser workbench at `/apps/quiz/`. Targets
> `[%zuse 408]`. Random checks are evidence, not proof. Each user call has a
> `%jinx` CPU limit; there is no memory isolation.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): installation, quick start, library-only use
- [User's guide](desk/doc/users-guide.md): nineteen-chapter tutorial, property-design advice
- [Reference](desk/doc/reference/engine-and-library.md): public contracts, limits, outcomes, troubleshooting
- [Limitations](desk/doc/reference/limitations.md): safety boundaries, unsupported behavior, operational caveats
- [Examples catalog](desk/doc/reference/examples.md): bundled examples with recorded results

## Contracts

- [Property documents](desk/doc/reference/source-format.md): `++fate`, `++norn`, `++alts`, `++conf`, restricted Ford prelude
- [Suites and replay](desk/doc/reference/suites-and-replay.md): `test-*` discovery, aggregation, replay inputs, regression suites
- [Agent API](desk/doc/reference/agent-api.md): `%quiz-action` pokes, `%quiz-update` facts, scries
- [HTTP API](desk/doc/reference/http-api.md): routes, authentication, JSON shapes
- [Workbench](desk/doc/reference/workbench.md): explorer, documents, run controls
- [Keyboard shortcuts](desk/doc/keyboard/quiz-keys.md)
- [Public types](desk/sur/quiz-app.hoon): request, record, outcome, state

## Source

- [Quiz library](desk/lib/quiz.hoon) and [generator](desk/gen/quiz.hoon): `check` inside ordinary code and suites
- [App engine](desk/lib/quiz-engine.hoon): stepper, shrinking, limits
- [Document builder](desk/lib/quiz-build.hoon)
- [Property combinators](desk/lib/quiz-prop.hoon): reports, labels, coverage
- [Generator library](desk/lib/quiz-gen.hoon): generators, size combinators, shrinkers, alts adaptor
- [Function library](desk/lib/quiz-fun.hoon): generated, shrinkable, printable functions
- [Type-directed defaults](desk/lib/quiz-auto.hoon): default fill and sink from the sample's type
- [Agent harness](desk/lib/quiz-harness.hoon): pure model-based testing of a Gall agent's door
- [Suite runner](desk/lib/quiz-suite.hoon), [replay capture](desk/lib/quiz-replay.hoon) and [regression suites](desk/lib/quiz-regression.hoon)
- [Job lifecycle](desk/lib/quiz-job.hoon) and [Gall adapter](desk/lib/quiz-agent.hoon)
- [Web agent](desk/lib/quiz-web-agent.hoon), [HTTP codec](desk/lib/quiz-json.hoon), [workbench config](desk/lib/quiz-web.hoon) and [file roots](desk/lib/quiz-files.hoon)
- [Internal module map](desk/doc/reference/engine-and-library.md#internal-implementation-map)
